According to the comment in `engine/src/retrieval/router.ts:375-382`, the 3-15 token range was **widened from 6-15**.

The comment explains the reason:

> Widened from 6-15 so short natural-language questions get semantic recall (via RRF fusion with keyword search) instead of being stuck keyword-only.

This change ensures that queries with 3-5 tokens (like "how does auth work") now reach semantic search via L2_L3_HYBRID instead of being stuck in keyword-only L2 routing.
